clips.title: The story
paras: Rhahk'Zor is a hulking ogre serving as the head foreman within the Deadmines. Overseeing Edwin VanCleef's subterranean construction efforts, he keeps the Defias laborers and miners in line through sheer brute force and heavy-handed discipline.

Deep beneath the rolling hills of Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood has transformed the abandoned gold mines of Moonbrook into an underground fortress. Coordinating this sprawling construction requires harsh discipline, a role filled by the ogre Rhahk'Zor. Appointed as head foreman, he oversees the excavation crews and laborers, driving them forward to carve out tunnels and assemble VanCleef's secret projects.

Rhahk'Zor maintains order through relentless muscle rather than careful engineering. Armed with an immense stone-headed hammer, his idea of workplace supervision is direct and unforgiving. Defias diggers and goblin engineers alike step lively around him, knowing that falling behind schedule or showing defiance invites a crushing blow from the towering taskmaster.
